findings.detail: detect_sections is regex-only (_CJK_ORDINAL/_CHAPTER/_NUMERIC_HEADING) with no entity/metric literals; _content_lines drops '## ' page headers, '<!--' locator comments, '# ' lines and blanks; _is_heading caps title at 40 chars. chunk_spans clamps via min(offset, line_count) and drops empty trailing chunks. _FACT requires metric (2-12 CJK/alpha chars) immediately followed by ':' or '：' then signed decimal and optional unit, so colon-less '单位成本下降至每吨2.1万元' cannot match. _frontmatter payload contains page_count (ZR-501), homepage_identity (ZR-502), detected_entities (ZR-503) and document_structure (ZR-506, schema_version '1.0', sections/chunk_count/facts) together.
